title: Shrawan Yadav v. State of U.P. and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Petition disposed as infructuous; fresh order under Supply Code
headnote: The Electricity Department withdrew the recovery citation dated 31 August 2021 on 21 February 2024 for a procedural defect. The writ was disposed of as infructuous, with liberty to the Department to pass a fresh order strictly in accordance with the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Shrawan Yadav challenged a recovery citation dated 31 August 2021 issued by respondent no. 5 for electricity dues. The writ was listed afresh, the Electricity Department took time to obtain instructions, and the petition was then connected with Writ-C No. 3458 of 2024, with existing interim orders continued. By a short counter affidavit the Executive Engineer stated that the recovery certificate had been withdrawn on 21 February 2024 because of a procedural defect, the Department reserving liberty to pass a fresh order.

holding_units.topic: Fresh order after withdrawal of a recovery citation
holding_units.holding: The writ challenging the recovery citation dated 31 August 2021 is disposed of as infructuous once the Electricity Department withdraws the recovery certificate for a procedural defect. Any fresh order may be passed only by strictly following the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: No clause number is cited. Catalog hits UP-2005::6.3 and UP-2005::16.1.4 are not applied.

principle_tags.application: The Department had withdrawn the recovery certificate for a procedural defect and reserved liberty to proceed again. The Court treated the writ as infructuous and confined that liberty to the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity dues were payable, and the terms of any fresh recovery order
not_decided.note: The citation was withdrawn for an unidentified procedural defect. The Court did not examine the dues.
